[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** by IBM (4 courses): Explore AI concepts, including machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Data Visualization and Communication**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. **Data Visualization** by University of California, Berkeley (4 courses): Learn to communicate insights effectively using data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, and D3.js.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. **Data Science Communication** by University of California, Berkeley (4 courses): Develop skills to communicate data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
